title: IELTS Listening Part 1 Information-Point Blueprint — WRITE-side contract (v2 only)

form_group.description: v2: a non-empty string on EVERY item. null was v1's way of saying 'standalone gap-fill'; v2 makes every point declare which printed layout it belongs to, and validate_part1.py adds the relational constraints JSON Schema cannot express (contiguous item numbers and contiguity in the ordered evidence sequence). A continuous layout may cross a narrator window; each item's evidence window remains strict.

item_form.description: Restated here, identically to the read schema's top-level enum, so this document says outright what the generator may write. Part 1 delivers Form / Note / Table completion only; multiple_choice was removed when the client narrowed the brief and is legal ONLY inside the read schema's v1 branch. Not to be confused with type: "option", which names the kind of detail and remains a valid completion answer.
